title: Set Pacman mirrors by country
summary: Generate a new mirror list using only mirrors from specific countries. This can help improve download speeds by using geographically closer servers.

steps.explain: Generate a new mirror list using only mirrors from the specified countries. This requires administrator rights.

placeholders.name: COUNTRIES
placeholders.description: Comma-separated list of country names (e.g., United_States,France,Germany).

rollback.explain: If the selected country mirrors are problematic, you can regenerate the mirror list using the default fasttrack option.

warnings: After running this command, you must synchronize your database and update your system using 'sudo pacman -Syyu'.
